description: This file defines the abstract class CosmosOptions for configuring Azure Cosmos DB options, including connection setup methods and properties related to resource creation, throughput, and client options. It also defines an interface ICosmosOperationExecutor and its default implementation for executing Cosmos DB operations with retry logic on rate limiting.

classes.name: CosmosOptions
classes.description: Abstract class providing configuration options for Azure Cosmos DB in Orleans applications, including methods to set up the CosmosClient with different authentication mechanisms, throughput settings, and resource management options.

classes.name: ICosmosOperationExecutor
classes.description: Interface defining a method for executing Cosmos DB operations with support for retries.

classes.name: DefaultCosmosOperationExecutor
classes.description: Default implementation of ICosmosOperationExecutor with retry logic for rate-limiting errors.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Multiple overloads to configure the CosmosClient using connection string, endpoint with credentials, or a creation delegate.

methods.name: ExecuteOperation
methods.description: Executes Cosmos DB operations with retry logic handling 429 Too Many Requests.
